title: Grand Marché Guided Walking Tour With Local Guide
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Meet Québec’s Local Producers 

At the Grand Market of Québec City, discover the passion and creativity of local producers and artisans who proudly showcase the richness of Québec’s culinary traditions.

During your private visit, you may meet producers specializing in artisanal cheeses, local charcuterie, maple products, fresh berries and preserves, chocolates, pastries, cider, wine, and many other regional specialties.

Montmorency Falls in Winter 

Experience the spectacular beauty of Montmorency Falls during Québec’s winter season.

As temperatures fall, the landscape surrounding the falls is transformed into a breathtaking winter wonderland. Snow-covered cliffs, frozen rock formations, and massive accumulations of ice create a unique and dramatic scenery.
During your private visit, take time to admire the falls from different viewpoints, capture memorable photographs, and discover how Québec’s harsh winter climate transforms this powerful natural landmark.
